aboutMe.title: About me
aboutMe.description: After 6 years in finance, I transitioned into web development. Recently, I built a freelance e-commerce project using Shopify and Next.js, styled with Tailwind CSS, and optimized the user experience. I enjoy writing clean code and creating elegant, functional web interfaces.

journey.masterDesc: Graduated from Université Paris Nanterre in Banking, Money & Financial Markets. Thesis focused on Shadow Banking and financial stability.
journey.lazardDesc: Worked 9 months as Middle Office Rétrocessions, handling custodian certificates and retrocession fees.
journey.rothschildDesc: Managed retrocessions and monitored liabilities for 5 years. Participated in automation projects to improve processes.
journey.studiDesc: Completed full-stack training at Studi, final project in PHP/Symfony. Certified Web & Mobile Developer.
journey.udemyDesc: 84-hour React course with Jonas Schmedtmann. Learned Hooks, Redux, Context API, React Router, and Next.js. Also completed React + TypeScript course.
journey.freelanceDesc: Built an online store with Shopify and Next.js Commerce, styled with Tailwind CSS, optimized UX and performance.

triptrack.desc: Personal React app for solo or group trips: create a trip, add travelers, log expenses and locations. Track who paid what and where, hassle-free.

wildoasis.title: The Wild Oasis
wildoasis.desc: Client app for cabin booking, built with Next.js, Supabase, and React Query as part of Udemy training. Users can browse and book cabins easily.

reactbites.desc: Personal recipe app inspired by Marmiton – An intuitive platform to search recipes, check ingredients, and save favorite dishes.

zoo.desc: Zoo Arcadia is a web application built during my training. Visitors can discover animals and habitats, and the back-office manages animals, enclosures, and staff.

usePopcorn.desc: usePopcorn is a React app developed during my Udemy course. It allows searching movies, rating them, and saving favorites.

reactMentoring.desc: React Mentoring is a React + TypeScript app created during my Udemy course. It focuses on strict typing and typed state management.
